messages:
alex: Quick alert 1: customers using our SAML IdP are seeing assertion issuer mismatch plus SCIM deprovision 403s after the ISP edge change. KMS decrypt errors also in the same window. Anyone touching SAML or edge rewrite?

rita: I deployed a tiny header-normalization patch to the edge router at 2026-11-12T03:14Z to strip trailing slashes on host headers. Did that touch SAML endpoints?

eng-ops: Correlated logs show assertion.issuer=\"https://sso.customer.example/\" expected=\"https://sso.customer.example\" (no trailing slash) -> saml-verify rejecting assertion. scim-provisioner logs: 
```
2026-11-12T03:20:05Z ERROR saml-verify: invalid_issuer tenant=beta-corp issuer=\"https://sso.customer.example/\"
2026-11-12T03:20:05Z ERROR scim-provisioner: deprov failed tenant=beta-corp status=403
2026-11-12T03:20:06Z ERROR kms: Decrypt failed key=alias/scim-secrets err=InvalidCiphertextException ctx=\"{\\\"issuer\\\":\\\"https://sso.customer.example/\\\"}\"
```

security-bot: Change detected: edge-router header-normalize deployed by rita at 2026-11-12T03:14Z, removed trailing slash normalization exception for /saml/assert. Flagged medium risk; KMS InvalidCiphertext spike + saml_invalid_issuer metric rose.

oncall-nick: I'm oncall. Quick mitigation: 1) revert edge change for SAML routes (fast), 2) add hotfix to saml-verify to normalize issuer (accept with/without trailing slash), 3) run small rewrap for affected tenant blobs because encryption_context includes issuer string. Which should we do first?

alex: Revert edge for SAML now and push saml-verify hotfix to canary. Also capture CloudTrail and rotation logs for compliance.

rAita: Revert pushed for route /saml/assert at 03:26Z. Can confirm assertion acceptance increased. I'll follow with a PR to exclude SAML paths from global host normalization.

oncall-nick: Hotfix to saml-verify merged to canary (accept trailing slash). Backfills for 6 affected tenants queued. For rewrap: we should re-encrypt blobs using canonical issuer string. I'll run single-tenant rewrap test.

compliance-lina: Please attach edge change diff, KMS decrypt audit entries, and a list of affected tenants to INC-9900 for the compliance packet. Note temporary rewrap grants must be logged.

security-bot: Suggested runbook updates: do not include mutable URL formatting in encryption_context; add pre-deploy check for header normalization touching auth endpoints; alert on kms_invalid_ciphertext >5/min.

alex: Action items: rita - open PR to exempt SAML routes from header normalization (owner); oncall-nick - run staged rewrap and revoke any temp grants (owner); eng-ops - collect tenant impact list and attach artifacts (owner). Schedule 30m blameless postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
